== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Sandvipers]] are a group of warriors characterized by their use of serpent parasites, which are small creatures attached to their limbs. These insectoid or reptilian companions can hiss, whistle warnings, or use claws. Members of this group, such as [[Resh]] and [[Tern]], exhibit varying degrees of confidence, though some are described as cowardly or nervous. Their territory is centered around a large, multi-peaked red tent where their leadership resides in luxury, while lower-ranking members live in makeshift huts. Their combat style relies heavily on poison, toxins, and corrosion, a magical discipline known as [[Sandviper madra]] that originated in the swamps to adapt to the corruption of the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]]. To survive their own lethal abilities, practitioners utilize a technique called the [[Bloodforged Iron body]] and must consume the blood of a sandviper to prevent their own venom from destroying their internal organs.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|This creature is a tan centipede featuring a carapace the color of sandy dunes. It possesses a head shaped like a snake, two rows of insect claws, and a tail ending in a scorpion's stinger.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The sandviper is a tan centipede characterized by its sandy dune colored carapace, snake-like head, two rows of insect claws, and a scorpion's stinger tail. These creatures have left behind [[Remnants]] that provide impressions of their existence. During an encounter, one sandviper hissed and bared its fangs at [[Lindon]] while a second scuttled toward him, maintaining a wary distance from its twin. [[Eithan]] later produced a live specimen of the creature, which [[Lindon]] was able to observe using his heightened senses.}}
